description: Convert a numeric value from one unit to another. Accepts unit names, symbols or aliases (e.g. 'km', 'miles', 'tola'). Both units must belong to the same measurement category.

categoryId.description: Optional category id to disambiguate units that exist in several categories.

from.description: Source unit name, symbol or alias.

to.description: Target unit name, symbol or alias.

name: convert_units
title: Convert units
